gems.title: 完美骗子
gems.summary: 茱德德里带着秘密任务踏入了精英贵族学校塔古斯大学，目标是打入卡什兄弟的圈子，查明她哥哥的死亡真相。一场始于复仇的行动，逐渐演变成由诱惑、禁忌吸引和谎言交织而成的危险三角博弈，将她推向一个她可能还没准备好面对的真相。本片改编自艾力克斯米雷茲的小说。
gems.summaryEn: Jude Derry arrives at the exclusive Tagus university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. What begins as revenge turns
gems.whyWatch: 校园复仇外壳下包裹禁忌三角与层层谎言，反转感强、青春悬疑气质新鲜。
gems.whyWatchEn: A campus revenge thriller wrapped in forbidden attraction and layered lies, with strong twists and a fresh youthful mystery vibe.
gems.audience: 喜欢青春悬疑、反转爽剧和危险关系设定的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy youthful mysteries, twisty dramas, and dangerous relationship dynamics

gems.title: 野兽之心
gems.summary: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。
gems.summaryEn: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for
gems.whyWatch: 退役战犬与老兵在极地荒野相依求生，情感克制却张力十足，是低调的生存冒险佳作。
gems.whyWatchEn: A veteran and his retired war dog survive together in the polar wilderness, delivering restrained emotion and tense survival thrills.
gems.audience: 喜欢生存冒险、动物情感和紧凑叙事的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who like survival adventure, animal bonds, and tight storytelling

gems.title: 寒夜怪谈
gems.summary: 改编自查尔斯·狄更斯小说《圣诞颂歌》。一位年迈的吝啬商人遭遇故友亡灵及圣诞过去、现在与未来的幽灵造访，被迫直面自己的过往，并踏上一段寻求幸福与救赎的超自然旅程。
gems.summaryEn: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past
gems.whyWatch: 把《圣诞颂歌》改写成暗黑奇幻怪谈，节日救赎与超自然恐怖混搭，辨识度很高。
gems.whyWatchEn: A dark fantasy reimagining of A Christmas Carol, blending holiday redemption with supernatural horror for a highly distinctive take.
gems.audience: 偏爱经典新编、暗黑童话和超自然氛围的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who prefer reimagined classics, dark fairy tales, and supernatural atmosphere

gems.title: 魔法秘境
gems.summary: 一名冲动、不拘一格的少女比莉意外发现自己拥有隐藏的魔法能力，由此进入广阔的女巫王国赫克塞。她与谨慎的母亲艾丽丝联手，揭开可能改变女巫世界的家族秘密。
gems.summaryEn: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch rea
gems.whyWatch: 少女意外闯入女巫王国，母女联手揭开家族秘密，家庭奇幻动画的设定轻盈又有新意。
gems.whyWatchEn: A headstrong girl discovers hidden magic and enters a witch kingdom, teaming with her cautious mother to uncover family secrets in a lively family fantasy.
gems.audience: 适合全家观看，也适合喜欢魔法世界与成长故事的观众
gems.audienceEn: Great for family viewing and fans of magical worlds and coming-of-age stories

gems.whyWatch: 老将新兵设定让警匪单元剧保有轻喜剧节奏，人物成长线稳扎稳打，适合下饭追看。
gems.whyWatchEn: The veteran-rookie setup keeps this cop procedural light and comedic, with steady character growth that makes it an easy binge.
gems.audience: 喜欢轻松警匪单元剧和人物成长线的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy light cop procedurals and character-growth arcs

gems.title: 镀金时代
gems.summary: 年轻的玛丽安·布鲁克从宾州乡下搬到纽约继承大量遗产的姑姑家，并不经意地被卷入了姑姑与富豪邻居的镀金时代社交争斗中。
gems.summaryEn: 年轻的玛丽安·布鲁克从宾州乡下搬到纽约继承大量遗产的姑姑家，并不经意地被卷入了姑姑与富豪邻居的镀金时代社交争斗中。
gems.whyWatch: 纽约镀金时代社交场中的阶级暗战与女性处境，服化道精致、群像慢热耐品。
gems.whyWatchEn: Class warfare and women's lives in Gilded Age New York society, with exquisite period detail and a slow-burn ensemble.
gems.audience: 偏爱精致服化道、慢热群像和年代社交剧的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who love lush period detail, slow-burn ensembles, and society dramas

gems.title: 龙珠超：比鲁斯
gems.titleEn: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
gems.summary: 魔人布欧之战结束数年后，地球重归和平。沉睡已久的破坏神比鲁斯苏醒，听闻打败弗利萨的赛亚人孙悟空后，突然现身地球。面对拥有毁灭星球之力的比鲁斯，悟空和伙伴们迎来关乎地球存亡的宇宙级战斗。
gems.summaryEn: 魔人布欧之战结束数年后，地球重归和平。沉睡已久的破坏神比鲁斯苏醒，听闻打败弗利萨的赛亚人孙悟空后，突然现身地球。面对拥有毁灭星球之力的比鲁斯，悟空和伙伴们迎来关乎地球存亡的宇宙级战斗。
gems.whyWatch: 破坏神比鲁斯登场把龙珠战斗抬到宇宙尺度，高燃作画与压迫感兼具，是补番佳选。
gems.whyWatchEn: Beerus's arrival raises Dragon Ball battles to a cosmic scale, combining high-energy animation with overwhelming pressure.
gems.audience: 龙珠粉丝以及想看高燃宇宙级战斗的动画观众
gems.audienceEn: Dragon Ball fans and anime viewers looking for high-energy cosmic battles
